verdict.rationale: AutoGen's core AgentChat/Python API exposes agents, teams, tools, memory, and orchestration fully in code, and AutoGen Studio itself can export visual team configs to Python, suggesting most UI-built workflows are reproducible via API. However, there's no explicit documentation confirming full parity (e.g., component discovery/import hub, docker execution controls) is scriptable outside the Studio UI, and no API reference or OpenAPI spec was found (probes returned 404s). missing for 10: explicit parity documentation between AutoGen Studio UI features (community hub, drag-and-drop) and equivalent API calls, and a discoverable API/OpenAPI reference.
